items.reason: Inclusion: 'Participant must have a diagnosis of high grade (WHO Grade III or IV) glioma'. Grade 4 is explicitly allowed, there is no IDH requirement and glioblastoma is never named, which is exactly the D30-R7 case (include as historical glioblastoma).
Coder A's doubt (whether 'WHO Grade III or IV' glioma names GBM) is resolved by D30-R7.
D30-R7 gives cns5_terminology historical for grade III-IV glioma without an IDH requirement.

note: EARLY_PHASE1: translational subset only (D23), not in the primary estimand. Under D30-R7 it is removed in the GBM-only and CNS5-only sensitivity analyses. The supportive premedications (folic acid, vitamin B12, dexamethasone, ibuprofen) listed only by coder A are priority-3 items and do not affect candidates.
